Print the agent documents of the installed package

Source: R/use-agent-docs.R
agent_docs.Rd

With no topic, prints the topics, one per line. With a topic ("skill", "syntax" or "reports"), prints that document as the installed package ships it, without its marker line. The copies use_agent_docs() writes into a project can be older than the package; this prints the version that matches the installed code. Nothing is written.

Usage

agent_docs(topic = NULL)

Arguments

topic

NULL, or one of "skill", "syntax", "reports".

Value

The text as a character vector of lines, invisibly (the topics when topic is NULL).

Details

The text has the installed package's version in the skill front matter, where use_agent_docs() writes the same version into a copy.
